searchText: here’s how it all breaks down...  $600 in from the 10 teams  $150 for the website is subtracted.   so, that leaves $165 to the playoff winner and $165 to the points winner.   $60 goes to the playoff runner up and point runner up.   so, i owe you $105 since you hadn’t paid the $60 yet. i’ll just deduct the $60 from the winnings are owed which gets it to $105.   that all make sense? det brian britten
